ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
en: By the sun and its brightness
id: Demi matahari dan cahayanya di pagi hari,

en: And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
id: maka Allah mengilhamkan kepada jiwa itu (jalan) kefasikan dan ketakwaannya.

en: He has succeeded who purifies it,
id: sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang yang mensucikan jiwa itu,

en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
id: dan sesungguhnya merugilah orang yang mengotorinya.

en: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
id: (Kaum) Tsamud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas,

en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
id: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka,

ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
id: lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka: ("Biarkanlah) unta betina Allah dan minumannya".

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
id: Lalu mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelih unta itu, maka Tuhan mereka membinasakan mereka disebabkan dosa mereka, lalu Allah menyama-ratakan mereka (dengan tanah),

en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
id: dan Allah tidak takut terhadap akibat tindakan-Nya itu.
